notes:
- **Your agent can read your Zoom calls, with no Zoom account and nothing to connect.** When you
  record a Zoom meeting, Zoom saves it in a folder on this computer. Archie reads what is in that
  folder and writes up what was said, here, with nothing sent anywhere. Turn it on under
  Connections, then Apps, then Zoom. Only calls you host are saved that way, and only the ones you
  pressed Record on, unless you have turned on "Record automatically as I start a meeting" in Zoom.
- Zoom often writes the transcript itself, and when it has, that is what Archie reads: it says who
  said which line, it takes no time, and it uses none of this computer's power. A call with no
  transcript beside it is transcribed here instead, and then the write-up says what was discussed
  and who was on the call but never who said what, because the audio does not carry that.
- **Meeting Notes reads whichever meeting source you have**, and any one of them is enough. A
  recording on this computer, a Fireflies key, or both. The card that asks for one no longer reads
  as though Fireflies were the only answer.
- **Your agent tells you what it is costing you.** A week after you start it says what it has spent
  so far and what that works out to over a month, then once a month after that. It says nothing at
  all rather than guess when it cannot put a price on something.
- **Ask about your week and it reads every calendar you have connected**, not just the first one.
  Booking something asks which calendar it should go on, when there is more than one to choose
  from, and the confirmation says which one before you press it.
- **A list can point at another list.** When you build a list on the Records tab, a text column can
  name the list it points at, and then you pick a row from a menu instead of typing its name.
  Tasks now point at Projects that way, so "what is left on the kitchen" is a question with an
  answer.
- **A routine's report can ride the next one.** Switch on "Fold into the next routine message" and
  that routine goes quiet and arrives underneath the next one that speaks, so a morning is one
  message rather than four. Nothing is lost if there is no next one: it goes out on its own after
  six hours.
- **Text Replies can watch group chats.** It is off until you switch it on, under Which texts to
  watch, because a reply you send from a card there goes to everyone in the group. With it on, a
  card says who spoke and in which group, and a promise you make in a group is remembered against
  the person you made it to.
- **A promise you make in a text is now on your Commitments list**, not only a reminder. So it can
  be asked about, chased on the days the sweep keeps, and closed, the same as one you made in an
  email.
- **"Who owes me a reply" counts what you asked a group**, not only what you asked one person.
- The Connections tab's Apps list now says which half you are looking at: what this agent already
  reaches, then a line, then what it could. The first tile of the catalog used to read as one more
  connected app.
- Zoom, Cloudflare and the MCP servers have their own marks on that list instead of two gray
  letters.
- **On the plan with the AI included, your agent will not read your texts**, for the same reason it
  will not read your mail: on that plan it thinks on our account, and the person who texted you
  never agreed to that. Connect an AI account of your own and both start working, with nothing to
  switch. The note with 0.2.3 said email was the only thing that plan does not do. It is both.
- Archie writes dates the way your agent does now, month first, everywhere. Before, the app asked
  this computer how to write a date and the agent in the next pane wrote it the other way round.
- Getting started is shorter to read. The Setup tab shows what is needed to run and folds the rest
  to a line, the AI account pane offers three companies and a door instead of a wall, the box you
  type in has one button for adding a file or a picture, and the first screen leads with one line
  instead of five counts.
- When you let your agent interview you, what you say now fills in its settings, and it tells you
  what it filled in.
- Websites shows up on the Connections tab once something actually asks for it, instead of sitting
  there from the first day.
- **Fixed: a reply to a mail that copied other people went only to the sender.** Answering an
  introduction reached one of the two people in it, and only a note in brackets said so.
- Fixed: a second message in the same chat costs a fraction of what it used to. The line telling
  your agent the time was moving on every request and throwing away everything the provider had
  remembered; a chat's second turn now bills at about a fifth of what it did.
- Signing in records that you agreed to the Terms, with the version and the moment, and says so
  under the buttons.
